title: The Eastern road out of town
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：eastern　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eastern 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1956 the gardener wrote of ① an eastern road out of town in the notebook, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② so eastern that nobody in the garden would go near it. Three springs on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the gardener, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the eastern ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the eastern road out of town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook for April 1950 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too eastern to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the apprentice who had come to help; the eastern ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an eastern wind from the sea, and said that no apprentice in his right mind would call it ⑥ as eastern as the wind from the sea they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was eastern or not, and he said so.

By 1963 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something eastern, and nothing besides. The apprentice from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite eastern; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the eastern ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1966, twice over, she wrote of another eastern road out of town in the same notebook, and the work, which took two springs, seemed ⑨ no less eastern than anybody had expected. ⑩ The eastern wind from the sea that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1968, was the one she could never quite name; the eastern ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 东部（前置定语 an eastern road out of town：1956 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的那件东部的东路）
B. adj. 东部／东方（两处加强说法：so eastern that … 与 no less eastern than …）
C. adj. 东部／东方（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 东部（表语 too eastern to do：母亲觉得它太东部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 东方（前置定语 an eastern wind from the sea：叔叔把整件事称作一桩东方的风）
F. adj. 东方（同级比较 as eastern as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩东面海上吹来的风相比）
G. adj. 东方（后置定语 something eastern：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 东方（受程度副词修饰 quite eastern：那位学徒的评价）

items.q: an eastern road out of town
the eastern road out of town that
an eastern wind from the sea
The eastern wind from the sea that

answers.why: eastern 意为“东部”，1956 年园丁在园艺笔记里记下的是“一件东部的东路”，此处作前置定语 an eastern road out of town。
eastern 意为“东部”，此处用 so eastern that 结构，说它东部到园子里没人敢靠近。
eastern 意为“东部”，园艺笔记上 四月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的东部出城的东路，等于最高级的说法。
eastern 意为“东部”，母亲认为这件东西“太东部了，谁也用不上”，too eastern to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
eastern 意为“东方”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩东方的风”，此处作前置定语 an eastern wind from the sea。
eastern 意为“东方”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩东面海上吹来的风一样东方”，同级比较用 as eastern as。
eastern 意为“东方”，园艺笔记上那半行字要的是“东方的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something eastern。
eastern 意为“东方”，邻园子来的那位学徒认为这套计划“相当东方”，quite 修饰原级 eastern。
eastern 意为“东方”，no less eastern than 表示“其东方不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之东方不亚于任何人的预料。
eastern 意为“东方”，母亲 1968 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的东方风”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1956 年，园丁在园艺笔记里记下了一件东部的东路。（an eastern road out of town）
它东部到园子里没有一个人敢靠近。（so eastern that …）
母亲觉得它太东部，谁也用不上。（too eastern to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩东方的风。（an eastern wind from the sea）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩东面海上吹来的风一样东方。（as eastern as …）
到了 1963 年，园艺笔记上只剩半行字：要的是一件东方的东西。（something eastern）
answers: In 1956 the gardener wrote of an eastern road out of town in the notebook.
It was so eastern that nobody in the garden would go near it.
My mother thought it too eastern to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an eastern wind from the sea.
He said nobody would call it as eastern as the wind from the sea they had once had.
By 1963 the notebook asked for nothing but something eastern.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 eastern 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1956 the gardener wrote of an eastern road out of town in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the eastern road out of town that anybody there had ever seen, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too eastern to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an eastern wind from the sea, and nobody argued with him.
The apprentice from the next garden called the plan quite eastern, and everybody laughed.
The eastern ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
